title: Spectrality of product-form self-similar measures and tiles
summary: This paper studies the Fourier properties of self-similar measures and tiles generated by digit sets of product-form. Let $0 <ρ<1$ be a real number and let $D$ be the direct sum of two consecutive integer sets: $$D=\{0,1,\cdots,N-1\}\oplus m\{0,1,\cdots, L-1\},$$ where $N, m, L \in \mathbb{N}^{*}$ with %$N, L \geq 2$ $N, L \geq 2$. The pair $(ρ,D)$ determines the self-similar iterated function system (IFS) $ \{φ_d(\cdot)=ρ(\cdot+d)\}_{d \in D}$.
